patch.value: Research current official Home Assistant 2026.7 documentation and tagged Core source; implement typed bounded subscriptions with deterministic filtering and normalized envelopes; cover transport, command, help, format, docs, live read-only, package, and release behavior; preserve raw WebSocket passthrough for forward compatibility.
Add token-efficient entity deltas and automation platform discovery

Expose current Home Assistant subscribe_entities and trigger/condition platform subscription contracts as typed bounded agent-native CLI workflows, with live 2026.7 validation and release-safe PM evidence.

Built hassio provides bounded entity-delta watching with entity/domain filters, max-event and duration limits, deterministic normalized output, and explicit unsubscribe cleanup; Built hassio provides bounded trigger and condition platform discovery using current Home Assistant subscription contracts; All output formats and schema/help surfaces document stable programmatic envelopes; All source tests retain exact 100/100/100/100 coverage and repository quality/release gates pass; Live Home Assistant 2026.7.4 read-only acceptance succeeds without persisting private payloads
Official docs, tagged Core 2026.7.4 source, live instance version, all-status PM lineage, GitHub issues/PRs, installed dependency types, and release failure logs inspected
Let agents observe only meaningful state changes and discover automation primitives without polling full state snapshots or parsing raw protocol envelopes.
Reduces token and bandwidth cost while making current Home Assistant automation capabilities directly usable in safe programmatic workflows.
A typed, documented, production-ready live observation and automation discovery surface with exact release evidence.
Home Assistant 2026.7 promotes purpose-specific automations and its current Core protocol offers delta subscriptions not yet modeled by the CLI.
